name: Yoshitomo Chihara
title: Director

message.text: Hello. My name is Yoshitomo Chihara, and I am the director of Norris Clinic. I previously worked as a urologist at a general hospital/clinic. While performing highly difficult plastic surgery techniques, I became fascinated with the pursuit of this technique. The patient will be happy with what he or she has designed and it will take shape with his or her own hands, and the patient will feel happy for the rest of his or her life.

I decided to pursue a career in aesthetic medicine as a place where I could make the most of my skills. In clinical aesthetic medicine, a design that more closely reflects the wishes of the patient is required. We will select the treatment method by providing counseling, including advice from a doctor, while considering the patient's wishes first.
Nothing can replace the joy I feel when I see a patient's smile after treatment or when I hear them say, ``I'm glad I received the treatment.''

We want Norris Clinic to be a place where you can feel free to consult when you have a problem or problem, just like a medical institution that treats illness or injury. Regardless of the level of your problem, please feel free to contact us. We are looking forward to the day when we can meet everyone.
